title: The name derivation case checked the task branch but not the working directory, so an adapter with a misnamed or misplaced directory passed
resolution: The fixture names its data root and the case compares each working directory with worker/workspaces/<name>/checkout under it; a double that percent-encodes the directory name failed nothing before and fails the case after

title: The design's example of why safe identifiers keep the digest named a pair that does not collide
resolution: The example is now the safe identifier a_b-<digest of a/b>, whose name would equal that of a/b; no other record or comment held the example

title: The name derivation case removed only one of the workspaces that contract section 12 says can be removed, so a removal that misnames another identifier passed
resolution: The case removes every workspace and checks that none is listed; a double whose removal looks for the digest-only workspace of .. under another name passed before and fails the case after.

title: Nothing said whether the fixture's data root is canonical, so the working directory comparison could fail falsely under a linked temporary directory
resolution: The fixture and contract section 12 require the canonical data root without symbolic links, design D7 says why, and the double's fixture resolves it with realpath.

title: Task 2.2 said two new defects while the proposal and design D7 said three
resolution: Task 2.2, the proposal, and design D7 say four, with the defect added for the removal of every workspace.

title: The verification record gave the results before the pass 1 fixes without a head and after the later ones
resolution: Each result in Checks and results names its head, in time order.

title: Design D5 did not name Web Crypto among the rejected alternatives
resolution: D5 rejects crypto.subtle.digest because it is asynchronous and would make the naming functions and the suite's name constants asynchronous.

title: The contract said identifiers are printable ASCII characters, though Identifier excludes space
resolution: The contract and the proposal say printable ASCII characters other than space.
